drivingQuestion: Who may perform ritual slaughter, and when is the slaughter of one who lacks competence valid?
outcomeNote: A mishna stating a rule and its qualification; no named tanna, no dispute and no interaction between parties, so the interaction list is legitimately empty.

segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ הַכֹּל שׁוֹחֲטִין וּשְׁחִיטָתָן כְּשֵׁרָה, חוּץ מֵחֵרֵשׁ שׁוֹטֶה וְקָטָן, שֶׁמָּא יְקַלְקְלוּ אֶת שְׁחִיטָתָן. וְכוּלָּן שֶׁשָּׁחֲטוּ וַאֲחֵרִים רוֹאִין אוֹתָן – שְׁחִיטָתָן כְּשֵׁרָה.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «Everyone slaughters» an animal, i.e., can perform halakhically valid slaughter, «and their slaughter is valid, except for a deaf-mute, an imbecile, and a minor, lest they ruin their slaughter» because they lack competence. «And» for «all of them, when they slaughtered» an animal «and others see» and supervise «them, their slaughter is valid.»

moves.summary: everyone may slaughter, except a deaf-mute, an imbecile and a minor, lest they ruin the slaughter
the exclusion is qualified: under supervision even their slaughter is valid
